name: REFRIGERATED CENTRIFUGE
desc: Standard Benchtop Microprocessor-Controlled Refrigerated Centrifuge designed for diverse testing and research laboratories. Equipped with a high-performance brushless motor, dual manual and electronic lid locks, LCD display for real-time parameter tracking, and an advanced CFC-free compressor cooling system operating down to -20°C.
features: Advanced CFC-free compressor cooling system (down to -20°C)
Intelligent Rotor Imbalance Diagnostics with Automatic Stop
Advanced Dual Safety Lid Lock System (Manual and Electronic)

specifications.Equipment Purpose: To centrifuge different kinds of samples in testing and research labs
specifications.Lid Lock Mechanism: Advanced Dual Safety System (Both Manual and Electronic)
specifications.Rotor Configuration: Supplied High-Grade Autoclavable Angle Rotor (At 121°C standard)
specifications.Rotor Capacity & Speed: 6 × 50 mL capacity with operational speed up to 13000 RPM
specifications.Monitored Parameters: Continuous display of RPM, RCF, Set Time, Run Time, and Imbalance
specifications.Safety Diagnostics: Intelligent Rotor Imbalance Diagnostics with Automatic Stop features
specifications.Timer Settings Range: Programmable from 1 Minute to 9 Hours 59 Minutes
specifications.Temperature Controller: Microprocessor-based PID Digital Temperature Controller cum Indicator
specifications.Chamber Bowl Material: Premium Corrosion-Resistant Stainless Steel Bowl with Zinc-Coated Armor Ring
specifications.Outer Body Material: Heavy-Gauge C.R.C Steel Finish with Protective Powder Coating
specifications.Front Panel / Lid Construction: High-Impact PC-ABS Plastics & Powder Coated CRC Steel Finish
specifications.Physical Dimensions (W x D x H): Compact 300 mm x 300 mm x 300 mm footprint
specifications.Warranty Cover: 2 Years Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty for Equipment & Rotor
